name: minecraft-server-panel
description: 一个用于管理Minecraft服务器的现代化面板

scripts.install: concurrently "pnpm run install:client" "pnpm run install:client-server" "pnpm run install:server"
scripts.dev: concurrently "pnpm run dev:client" "pnpm run dev:client-server" "pnpm run dev:server"
scripts.build: concurrently "pnpm run build:client" "pnpm run build:client-server" "pnpm run build:server"
scripts.start: concurrently "pnpm run start:client" "pnpm run start:client-server" "pnpm run start:server"
